item.title: Agios Dionysios Church in Zakynthos
item.description: The largest and probably the most famous church on the island is located in the capital of Zakynthos. The church of St. Dionysus, the patron saint of Zakynthos, together with the tall white bell tower, forms a beautiful landmark of the harbour. The current appearance of the church dates back to the mid-20th century. The post Agios Dionysios Church in Zakynthos appeared first on Greek City Times.
